requirements.rule: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: EDR: the EDR of EUR 10.33/month (agreement 26 Jan 2001) is conglobated into the minimum pay tables (Art. 61 note). The EDR of art. 60 c. 8 (workers in service on 26 January 2011) and the EDR of the agreement of 18 May 2021 (13 mensilità, no effect on other institutes) are paid as allowances; the 2021 EDR may still enter the daily base of absences and sickness, which 'nessuna incidenza su alcun istituto contrattuale' excludes.
requirements.remediation: Exclude EDR_2021 from the daily base of absences and sickness (a relevance flag on the allowance), or source that it enters it.

requirements.rule: HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS: Sanilog (Art. 51, p. 64): 150 euro a year for each worker not in probation with a permanent contract or an apprenticeship, from the employer only, plus the 10% INPS solidarity contribution; Ebilog (Art. 52, p. 65): 3,50 euro a month from the employer and 0,50 euro from the worker, for 12 months, or an EAR of 8 euro a month paid to the worker by an employer outside the bilateral system. Not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Pass the contributions as bilateral fund events, or model them per worker.

requirements.rule: LEVEL 6° JUNIOR: not modelled. The profile existed only in 2025 (1,464.53 a month from 1.1.2025, p. 80; seniority step 18.78, art. 17; EDR 2021 7.58, p. 82) and ended on 31.12.2025 (p. 25: 'Il presente profilo avrà termine inderogabilmente il 31 dicembre 2025'), its workers moving to level 6; a level of the bundle must cover the whole span of the ruleset. The request has no override of the level amounts: a 2025 run of a 6J worker on level 6 pays the level 6 minimum (1,615.71) (review of 2026-10-30)
requirements.remediation: Model 6J for 2025 (a level closed on 2025-12-31, or a refusal of 6J runs), or record the limitation for 2025 runs.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: SIXTH DAY: Art. 13 c. 6 (p. 39) pays 50% for the overtime of the sixth day of a non-travelling worker whose normal week is spread over five days; the overtime bands have no such kind, so that overtime takes the 30% of the weekday band.
requirements.remediation: Add a sixth-day kind to the overtime event and a 50% band, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
requirements.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.
